schema.nodes:
CREATE TABLE nodes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schema.claims:
CREATE TABLE claims (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES nodes(id),
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schema.edges:
CREATE TABLE edges (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id),
    target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight REAL NOT NULL CHECK(weight > 0 AND weight <= 1),
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(source_id, target_id, kind)
)

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM nodes WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%self-avoiding%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%restriction%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%hexagonal%' LIMIT 12
